name.description: Option name. Returned as `choice` and used as the key in `probabilities`. Sent to the model.
name.title: Name

description.description: When this option applies. Omit when the name is clear on its own.
description.title: Description

ChoiceQuestion.description: Which of these options? For a fixed set of unordered options.

id.description: Your key for this question; the answer comes back under it. Not sent to the model.
id.title: Id

instructions.description: What the model should decide, written as a complete question.
instructions.title: Instructions

options.description: The answer options (at least 2). Give the full list, and add an `other` option when the list might not cover every input.
options.title: Options

ChoiceQuestion.title: ChoiceQuestion

NoulQuestion.description: Is this true? For a clean yes/no where the probability itself is the signal. OpenAI calls this a predicate.

id.description: Your key for this question; the answer comes back under it. Not sent to the model.
id.title: Id

instructions.description: The yes/no question, or a statement to judge. Make the boundary between yes and no unambiguous.
instructions.title: Instructions

criteria.description: Optional. Pins down a subtle yes/no boundary; appended to the instructions.

NoulQuestion.title: NoulQuestion

ScoreQuestion.description: Which level? For a position on a spectrum you can describe.

id.description: Your key for this question; the answer comes back under it. Not sent to the model.
id.title: Id

instructions.description: What the model should rate, written as a complete question.
instructions.title: Instructions

levels.description: Ordered level descriptions, low end to high end. A level's number is its index, starting at 0.
levels.title: Levels

ScoreQuestion.title: ScoreQuestion

state.description: The text to evaluate: a string, or a JSON object / array of related context, sent as JSON text. Every question sees the same state and images. May be empty when `images` carries the content.
examples: Seller title: wireless earbuds, barely used
state.title: State

images.description: Up to 8 images the questions are about (PNG, JPEG or WebP). Every question sees them, placed before the state.
images.title: Images

choices.description: Choice questions: pick one option from a set.
choices.title: Choices

scores.description: Score questions: place the state on ordered levels.
scores.title: Scores

nouls.description: Noul questions: probability that the answer is yes.
nouls.title: Nouls

model.description: The OpenAI model that evaluates the questions. The Decisions API supports `gpt-6-luna` only for now.
model.title: Model
